verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a headless HTTP server (`opencode serve`) that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint, and a probe confirms a live openapi.json spec. A type-safe JS/TS SDK is documented for controlling opencode programmatically. A community user independently confirms running `opencode serve`, reaching it remotely, and connecting multiple backends from the WebUI. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond JS/TS, and documented authentication for the server API (a community report says the local server accepts unauthenticated requests).
